# Correlations between scRNA and flow cytometry
```{r}
raw_process_data <- fetch_rds("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cgtc/plasticell_flow_analysis/main/00_data/multiomics_process_data/raw_process_data.rds")

r3_fcm_target_variable <- raw_process_data[["r3_process_data"]]

r4_fcm_target_variable <- raw_process_data[["r4_process_data"]]

write.csv(r3_fcm_target_variable, here("00_data", "fcm_nk_cell_percentages_run_3.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(r4_fcm_target_variable, here("00_data", "fcm_nk_cell_percentages_run_4.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
r3_cd45_cd56 <- r3_fcm_target_variable |> 
    # select only rows with suspension as cell portion
    filter(`Cell portion` == "Suspension") |> 
    # select only the columns we need
    select(Label, "CD45+/CD56+ (%)...63", "CD45+/CD56+ (%)...64") |> 
    # calculate mean of those two columns
    mutate(proportion_NK = rowMeans(pick("CD45+/CD56+ (%)...63", "CD45+/CD56+ (%)...64"), na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    drop_na(proportion_NK)

r4_cd45_cd56 <- r4_fcm_target_variable |> 
    # select only rows with suspension as cell portion
    filter(`Cell portion` == "Suspension") |> 
    # select only the columns we need
    select(Label, "CD45+/CD56+ (%)...63", "CD45+/CD56+ (%)...64") |> 
    # calculate mean of those two columns
    mutate(proportion_NK = rowMeans(pick("CD45+/CD56+ (%)...63", "CD45+/CD56+ (%)...64"), na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    drop_na(proportion_NK)

cd45_cd56_data <- r3_cd45_cd56 |> 
    bind_rows(r4_cd45_cd56) |> 
    select(Label, proportion_NK)
```


```{r}
run_3_scrna_identity <- read_csv(here("00_data", "nk_cell_percentages_run_3.csv")) |> 
    mutate(run = 3) |> 
    # extract vessel number from string like "V01" but only the number as numeric
    mutate(vessel = as.numeric(str_extract(vessel_day, "(?<=V)\\d+"))) |> 
    # extract day number from string like "D1" or "D35" but only the number as numeric
    mutate(day = as.numeric(str_extract(vessel_day, "(?<=D)\\d+"))) |> 
    # make labels like r3_v4_d6
    mutate(label = paste0("r", run, "_v", vessel, "_d", day))

run_4_scrna_identity <- read_csv(here("00_data", "nk_cell_proportions_run_4.csv")) |> 
    mutate(run = 4) |> 
    # extract vessel number from string like "V01" but only the number as numeric
    mutate(vessel = as.numeric(str_extract(vessel_day, "(?<=V)\\d+"))) |> 
    # extract day number from string like "D1" or "D35" but only the number as numeric
    mutate(day = as.numeric(str_extract(vessel_day, "(?<=D)\\d+"))) |> 
    # make labels like r3_v4_d6
    mutate(label = paste0("r", run, "_v", vessel, "_d", day))

scrna_target_variable <- run_3_scrna_identity |> 
    select(label, vessel, day, proportion_NK) |> 
    bind_rows(run_4_scrna_identity |> 
        select(label, vessel, day, proportion_NK))
```

```{r}
fcm_scrna_data <- scrna_target_variable |> 
    select(label, proportion_NK) |> 
    inner_join(cd45_cd56_data, by = c("label" = "Label"), suffix = c("_scrna", "_fcm")) |> 
    rename(proportion_NK_scrna = proportion_NK_scrna, proportion_NK_fcm = proportion_NK_fcm)

# calculate the strength of the correlation between the two methods
correlation <- cor(fcm_scrna_data$proportion_NK_scrna, fcm_scrna_data$proportion_NK_fcm, method = "pearson")
```

```{r}
ggplot(fcm_scrna_data, aes(x = proportion_NK_scrna, y = proportion_NK_fcm)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
    labs(title = paste("Correlation between scRNA and Flow Cytometry (r =", round(correlation, 2), ")"),
         x = "Proportion of NK cells (scRNA)",
         y = "Proportion of NK cells (Flow Cytometry)") +
    theme_catapult()
```
